text: 【下周关注：8月CPI数据即将公布 这些投资机会最靠谱】9月9日，国家统计局将公布8月CPI、PPI数据。此前数据显示，7月份，全国居民消费价格同比上涨0.5%。7月份，全国工业生产者出厂价格同比上涨3.5%，环比下降0.7%。
text_en: 【Next Week's Focus: August CPI Data Due, These Investment Opportunities Are Most Reliable】On September 9, the National Bureau of Statistics will release August CPI and PPI data. Previous data showed that in July, national consumer prices rose 0.5% year-on-year. In July, national producer prices for industrial products rose 3.5% year-on-year and fell 0.7% month-on-month.
